title: Correct flight time
description: Essential: Student must calculate the correct flight time using vertical motion equations, obtaining t = 1 s.

title: Correct horizontal range
description: Essential: Student must compute the horizontal distance using x = v₀t, obtaining x = 10 m.

title: Correct impact speed
description: Essential: Student must determine the final speed using vector addition of horizontal and vertical components, obtaining approximately 14.1 m/s.

title: Vertical motion analysis
description: Important: Student should apply kinematic equations for vertical free fall to find either flight time or vertical velocity.

title: Vector composition of velocity
description: Important: Student must recognize that final speed requires combining constant horizontal velocity with final vertical velocity.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (s, m, m/s) in all numerical answers.

title: Confusing horizontal and vertical motion
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses horizontal velocity in vertical motion equations or vice versa.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student makes sign errors in vertical acceleration or velocity components.
